name: Studio Ninja
description: Studio Ninja is a client and shoot management platform for photographers, combining leads, jobs, calendars, workflows, quotes, contracts, questionnaires, invoices, payments, email, and client portals. Photography businesses use it to organize bookings and automate client work from inquiry through delivery and payment.
agentUseSummary: Studio Ninja is not available as a direct Relay connection because the provider does not publish a supported developer API, OAuth application program, hosted MCP, or complete operation contract. Relay will not infer private application endpoints, automate the signed-in product, or treat Studio Ninja's named partner integrations as general access to customer accounts.

providerSetup.blocker: Studio Ninja's current official integration catalog documents six named product integrations but no public API, developer console, third-party OAuth application program, hosted MCP, endpoint schemas, permission model, quotas, credential lifecycle, webhook contract, or independent distribution terms. evidence.supports: Studio Ninja's official integration catalog lists six named integrations—Pic-Time, ProSelect, Fundy Designer, QuickBooks, Xero, and ShootProof—but no developer API, OAuth application program, hosted MCP, or general automation contract.
Studio Ninja's official migration guidance offers staff-assisted migration, manual transfer, and CSV client import rather than a supported programmatic API.
The official ShootProof article describes a specific embedded partner consent flow and gallery feature, not a reusable third-party Studio Ninja developer contract.
Studio Ninja's current official knowledge base documents product use and a bounded integrations collection but exposes no public developer documentation or API reference.
